No uncertain edges were promoted, no edges were added, and no label corrections were made in the final pass.
Final matrix contains 217 asserted undirected edges and exactly matches the agreed Jennifer round1 / Diego round2 matrix.
Accepted Jennifer's removal of SOL-SDV-A <-> DIODE-OR-A. The A-side raw crop separates the dashed DC-MCC-A-to-SOL-SDV-A control lead from the solid DIODE-OR-A-to-BUS-125A tap.
No disputed Jennifer removals: no direct visual segment was found between SOL-SDV-A and DIODE-OR-A under the solid=POWER/DC, dashed=CONTROL, dotted=INSTRUMENT legend rules.

The lower 125VDC/120VAC UPS section remains separated into A and B buses. BUS-125A/B and BUS-UPS-A/B do not show a direct tie; charger upstream feeds remain represented as logical AC FEED TO CHGR-125A/B nodes.

No remaining uncertain edge has enough direct visual support to assert. CT-to-RHR candidates remain sensing-adjacent rather than terminal-explicit, and PNL-120-to-PUMP-SI candidates remain dashed routes through the SI branch area without direct pump-symbol landings.
